verdict.rationale: Jina Reader supports proxy rotation, caching, and configurable fetch engines that hint at scale-friendly usage, but there's no direct evidence of rate limits, concurrency quotas, or documented guidance for running many parallel scraping sessions. Community reports note undocumented API limits and auth errors, suggesting scaling is not well-documented or guaranteed. Missing for 10: explicit concurrency/rate-limit documentation, benchmarks or case studies of large-scale parallel scraping, and confirmation that free/paid tiers support high-volume concurrent sessions.
